messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - inference-gateway error-rate alert. 5xx rate 4.2% over last 5m (threshold 1.0%). Region: us-east1. Automated page sent to current oncall. PD: https://pd.example.com/INC98765

 tasha: acked and taking. setting DND briefly. jumping into logs.

 lee: any recent canary or traffic-split changes? saw a small rollout to route 2 at 13:40 UTC.

 aman: confirmed: traffic-split canary for multi-model routing at 13:38 UTC, 2% traffic. No full deploy.

 tasha: reproducing with curl against gateway: getting 504s with body:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream closed connection","via":"model-worker-12"}
```

 infra-bot: host metrics for affected hosts: <link to metrics>. kernel dropped packets increased on host gw-12 and worker-12 around 13:39 UTC.

 lee: model-worker logs show repeated 'fatal: write failed: Broken pipe' and occasional oom-kill lines.

 aman: tail from model-worker-12:
```
2026-03-15T13:39:21Z model-worker-12: write() EPIPE
2026-03-15T13:39:21Z model-worker-12: oom_kill invoked pid=2234 rss=14GB
```

 tasha: mitigation plan: 1) enable runtime circuit-breaker to route to 'stable-small' for 2 minutes; 2) scale model-worker pool +2 replicas; 3) hold the traffic-split canary at 0% (pause). Applying step 1 now.

 incident-bot: Runtime config change applied by tasha at 13:45 UTC: inference.circuit_breaker=stable-small, duration_s=120

 lee: scaling workers now via autoscale override +2 replicas (staggered). will monitor.

 aman: paused canary in the console. change logged.

 tasha: after circuit-breaker enabled and scale-up, 5xx rate fell to 0.8% within 3m. Good signal. Keeping measures in place for now.

 eng-lead: nice work. collect core dumps and ask infra to confirm whether OOMs are caused by model-worker memory leak or spike in request size. If OOMs, prepare for rolling restarts with 30s drain.

 lee: collecting /var/log/kern.log and dmesg, pushing artifacts to https://artifacts.example.com/INC98765/logs

 aman: initial heap sampling from worker-12 shows memory growth correlated with specific batched requests. saving trace.

 tasha: customer impact: approx 1.9% of us-east1 requests affected during spike window. Tenants: beta-inc (45% of affected), media-corp (12%). Recommend emailing affected customers if incident persists beyond 90m. Support notified.

 oncall-rotation-bot: Infra oncall paged if no confirmation in 8m (PD INFRA-ONCALL).

 infra-bot: infra confirms NIC driver reported transient RX overruns on host gw-12. investigating driver firmware and host-level socket limits.

 tasha: plan next: keep circuit-breaker for 20m, monitor metrics, debug worker memory traces. If we see recurring OOMs after scale-up, schedule staggered restarts. Eng-lead please confirm communications cadence.

 eng-lead: acknowledged. escalate to L2 if not resolved in 25m. Prepare postmortem template draft. I'll own customer comms review.

 incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation scheduled in 25m. Action logged.

 tasha: 14:30 UTC summary: mitigation effective. 5xx at baseline ~0.5%. workers scaled and canary paused. ongoing investigation into memory growth and NIC overruns. will update at 15:00 or earlier for any regression.

 incident-bot: Incident INC98765 status: monitoring. last update by tasha at 14:30 UTC.
